    {'description': 'Entities the activity used. Per PROV-O each value '
                    'denotes a prov:Entity. An item may be (1) a string '
                    'URI or free-text reference, (2) an {@id} reference, '

                    'by shape rather than by name. Base leaves the wrapped '
                    'value loose; profiles/extensions (e.g. '
